name: Chicken Fried Rice

steps.text: Chop the chicken into 1/4 to 1/2 inch cubes. Sprinkle with the salt, mix, and set aside about 10 minutes.
Heat a wok over medium-high heat. Swirl in a tablespoon of oil, add the whisked eggs, and scramble. Transfer to a plate.
Add another tablespoon of oil. Cook the chicken 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Transfer to a plate.
Swirl in the remaining oil. Cook the onion 1 minute, then add garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the carrots, cook 2 minutes, then stir in the peas.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps. Stir in the white/light parts of the scallions and the five-spice powder.
Drizzle in the soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir in the cooked chicken, scrambled eggs, and the dark scallion greens. Cook 1-2 minutes and serve.

note: Source: TheMealDB (adapted from simplyrecipes.com). Onion and peas volumes are recipe-stated cup measures converted via ontology cupWeightG, not whole-unit counts.

name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole

steps.text: Cut each chicken breast into about 3 pieces and place in a small pot. Pour the enchilada sauce over it and cook, covered, on low-medium heat about 20 minutes until cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Preheat oven to 375F.
Spread about 1/4 cup of the leftover sauce in the bottom of a baking dish. Layer 2 tortillas, 1/3 of the chicken, 1/3 of the remaining sauce, and 1/3 of the cheese. Repeat twice more.
Bake uncovered 20-30 minutes until bubbly and the cheese browns on top. Serve warm.

note: Source: TheMealDB. 'Enchilada sauce' is a new canonical entry (jarred, condiment category) — no prior ontology entry covered it.

name: Brown Stew Chicken

steps.text: Squeeze lime over the chicken and rub well. Drain off excess lime juice.
Combine tomato, onion, garlic, bell pepper, thyme, allspice, and soy sauce in a large bowl with the chicken. Cover and marinate at least 1 hour.
Heat oil in a dutch pot. Shake seasonings off the chicken as you remove each piece from the marinade, reserving the marinade for later.
Lightly brown the chicken in batches in hot oil. Set browned pieces aside.
Drain excess oil, return chicken to the pan, pour in the marinade, and add the carrots. Cook over medium heat 10 minutes.
Mix cornstarch into the coconut milk and add to the pot, stirring constantly. Reduce heat to low and cook another 20 minutes until tender.

note: Source: TheMealDB. 'Whole chicken' and 'ground allspice' are new canonical entries. Recipe listed onion twice (marinade + separate chop); combined into a single line at 2 onions total per the source measures.

name: Sticky Chicken

steps.text: Make 3 slashes in each drumstick. Mix together the soy sauce, honey, oil, tomato puree, and mustard.
Pour the mixture over the chicken and coat thoroughly. Marinate 30 minutes at room temperature or overnight in the fridge.
Heat oven to 400F. Tip the chicken into a shallow roasting tray.
Roast 35 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and glistening with the marinade.

note: Source: TheMealDB (bbcgoodfood.com). 'Tomato puree' mapped to the existing tomato-paste entry (UK/US naming difference for the same product).

name: Spaghetti Bolognese

steps.text: Fry the onion in oil over fairly high heat 3-4 minutes. Add the garlic and beef and fry until both are browned.
Add the mushrooms and oregano, cook a couple more minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, beef stock, tomato puree, and Worcestershire sauce. Season.
Bring to the boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti in a large pan of boiling salted water per package instructions. Drain.
Stir the meat sauce into the spaghetti. Serve with grated Parmesan on top.

name: Baked Salmon with Fennel & Tomatoes

steps.text: Heat oven to 350F. Trim fennel fronds and set aside. Halve fennel bulbs, then cut each half into 3 wedges. Boil in salted water 10 minutes, drain.
Chop the fennel fronds and mix with parsley and lemon zest.
Spread fennel in a shallow ovenproof dish, add tomatoes, drizzle with olive oil, and bake 10 minutes.
Nestle the salmon among the vegetables, sprinkle with lemon juice, and bake 15 minutes more until just cooked. Scatter with the parsley mixture and serve.

name: Salmon Avocado Salad

Slice the avocados and cucumber. Divide spinach, avocado, and cucumber between plates, then drizzle with half the dressing.
Heat a non-stick pan. Fry the salmon 3-4 minutes each side until crisp outside, moist inside.
Put a salmon fillet on top of each salad, drizzle with remaining dressing, and serve warm.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork

steps.text: Separate the egg white and yolk. Slice the pork into strips.
Marinate the pork strips for 20 minutes in a pinch of salt, 1 tsp of the cornstarch, the soy sauce, and the egg white.
Mix the remaining cornstarch with a little water and vinegar to make a starchy sauce.
Heat oil in a wok to 375F. Fry the marinated pork until browned, then remove.
Add tomato puree and sugar to the wok, heat until combined. Add water, then return the pork.
Pour in the starchy sauce and stir-fry until everything is coated and thickened. Garnish with cilantro.

Serve with the remaining basil.

Divide the rice between bowls, top with the egg and pork mixture, sprinkle with chives, and serve immediately.

note: Previously skipped for the mirin — see DECISIONS.md, alcohol is no longer excluded from the ontology.

name: Beef Sunday Roast

ingredients.preparation: 8 slices of roast beef; source gave no weight, estimated 40g/slice
1 packet; source gave no weight, estimated 900g
1 packet; source gave no weight, estimated 500g
sunflower oil substituted; drizzle for the tins, estimated

tools: Yorkshire pudding tin or 12-hole muffin tin

steps.text: Cook the broccoli and carrots in boiling water until tender.
Roast the beef and potatoes in the oven 45 minutes, checking the potatoes regularly.
Heat the oven to 230C/fan 210C/gas 8. Oil the pudding tins and heat them in the oven.
Beat the flour with the eggs until smooth, then gradually beat in the milk until lump-free. Season.
Pour the batter into the hot tins and bake 20-25 minutes until puffed and browned. Serve everything together with gravy.
Sauté the onion in butter until translucent.
Add the corned beef and potatoes, spreading evenly. Cook on high heat, pressing down until browned.
Flip sections to brown both sides, adding more butter if needed.
Once browned, stir in the parsley and season with salt and pepper.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup

steps.text: Fry the onions, celery, carrots, potatoes, and bay leaves in the oil until the onions soften, 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree, sugar, vinegar, chopped tomatoes, and passata, then crumble in the stock cubes.
Add 1 litre boiling water and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the potato is tender. Remove the bay leaves.
Blend until smooth. Season to taste.
To serve, reheat gently and stir in the milk without letting it boil.

note: 1 litre of water added during cooking wasn't counted toward quantityG/estimatedYieldG since it's boiled and blended in rather than a discrete purchasable ingredient in the same sense as the rest — the yield figure understates the served volume.

ingredients.preparation: half a baguette, open-faced; approximated as white bread

steps.text: Mix the minced beef, onion, eggs, chilli, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Heat a pan or griddle with a little oil. Pour the mixture onto the pan and press an open-faced piece of baguette on top.
Grill 2 minutes, then flip the bread over to crisp it.
Remove from the pan, cut into portions, and top with mayonnaise before serving.

ingredients.preparation: 2 tsp juice, approximated as a fraction of a lemon

steps.text: Strain the yoghurt through kitchen paper in a sieve for at least 12 hours.
Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, and dried mint; combine with the strained yoghurt.
Halve the cucumber lengthwise, remove the seeds, grate it, and squeeze out the liquid.
Fold the grated cucumber, garlic, and salt into the yoghurt mixture. Garnish with olive oil and mint.
Rinse the lentils 2-3 times and drain.
Sauté the onion 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook 3 minutes more.
Stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the cumin, paprika, mint, thyme, black pepper, and red pepper flakes and stir 10 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add the lentils, water, broth, and salt. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat, cover halfway, and cook 15-20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Blend to the desired consistency and adjust seasoning.

name: Chicken Wings with Cumin, Lemon & Garlic

ingredients.preparation: each cut into 2 pieces at the knuckle

steps.text: Cut each wing at the knuckle into two pieces. Mix the garlic, lemon zest and juice, cumin, oil, and seasoning; toss with the wings.
Cover and marinate in the fridge at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bake on a tray 45-50 minutes until crisp, drizzling with honey for the final 10 minutes.

ingredients.preparation: scotch bonnet substituted — much milder heat, similar macros

steps.text: Add all the ingredients to a large pan over medium heat and cover with a lid.
Cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and cook 5 minutes more until the cabbage is soft and tender.
Remove the thyme sprigs before serving.

ingredients.preparation: chicken bouillon powder, 2 tsp approximated as half a cube

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes in half, remove the stems, and cut into thirds.
Cook the eggs in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until mostly set but slightly wet. Remove.
Stir-fry the tomatoes in the sesame oil until softened, then add the bouillon powder, sugar, and pepper.
Return the eggs to the pan and stir-fry 2 minutes. Garnish with green onion and serve with steamed rice.

ingredients.preparation: Chinese rice wine, for the beef marinade

steps.text: Marinate the beef in the soy sauce, sherry, cornstarch, and black pepper for 10 minutes.
Stir together the oyster sauce, sherry, soy sauce, and chicken broth for the sauce; set aside.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water about 2 minutes until crisp-tender. Drain.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot. Add the beef in a single layer and let fry undisturbed 1 minute.
Flip, add the garlic, and fry until the beef is no longer pink. Add the sauce and cornstarch slurry, stir until it boils and thickens. Stir in the broccoli and serve.
Peel the cucumbers and cut into quarters lengthwise, scraping out bitter seeds if needed.
Cut crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces.
Place in a serving bowl, sprinkle with salt, and toss with sesame oil, rice vinegar, basil, and chilli flakes.
Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds before serving.

ingredients.preparation: 3 tbsp chopped; source gave a volume measure, estimated
3 tbsp chopped; source gave a volume measure, estimated
handful; source gave no precise amount

steps.text: Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken until browned. Remove.
Reheat the wok, add the garlic and shallots, and cook until golden.
Return the chicken along with the chillies, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Cook until done.
Add the basil leaves and serve immediately.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the pumpkin with oil and seasoning in a roasting tin; roast 30 minutes until golden.
Cook the onion, ginger, and lemongrass in a pan with oil for 8-10 minutes.
Stir in the curry paste, roasted pumpkin, coconut milk, and stock. Simmer 5 minutes, then remove the lemongrass.
Blend until smooth. Season with salt, pepper, lime juice, and sugar. Serve with a swirl of coconut milk and chilli.

ingredients.preparation: handful; source gave no precise amount
handful; source gave no precise amount
roasted, handful; source gave no precise amount

steps.text: Put the carrots, cabbage, and onions in a bowl.
Stir together the lime juice, oil, chilli, and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Pour over the vegetables and toss.
Add the mint and coriander, toss again, then scatter over the peanuts.

ingredients.preparation: bunch; source gave no precise amount

steps.text: Put the cucumber in a sieve, sprinkle with salt and sugar, and leave 10 minutes. Add the fennel.
Mix the sour cream, lemon juice, vinegar, and dill, season with black pepper, and toss with the cucumber and fennel.

ingredients.preparation: Scotch bonnet substituted, removed before serving

steps.text: Combine the rice, coconut milk, kidney beans, water, salt, allspice, and black pepper in a large pot.
Top with the green onions, thyme, and Scotch bonnet pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 18 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit, covered, 5 more minutes. Remove the aromatics and fluff with a fork.

ingredients.preparation: Padron peppers substituted — small green peppers, similar macros, no dedicated entry

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat (or air-fry at 205C for 3 minutes).
Fry the peppers, stirring frequently, 5 minutes until blistered, wilted, and slightly charred.
Transfer to a serving plate and season with sea salt.

name: French Lentils With Garlic and Thyme

ingredients.preparation: French (green/brown) lentils substituted — same entry covers dried lentils generally

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan. Add the chopped vegetables and sauté until softened, 5-10 minutes.
Add the water, lentils, thyme, bay leaves, and salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a fast simmer.
Simmer 20-25 minutes until the lentils are tender and have absorbed most of the water. Drain any excess.

name: Chicken Basquaise

ingredients.preparation: handful; source gave no precise amount

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180C/gas mark 4. Brown the chicken in batches in the butter and oil, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Fry the onions 10 minutes until softened, then add the peppers for 5 minutes.
Add the chorizo, sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, rice, tomato paste, paprika, bay leaves, thyme, stock, and wine.
Cover and cook in the oven 50 minutes with the chicken on top, lemon wedges, and olives.

note: Previously would have been skipped for the wine — alcohol is no longer excluded, see DECISIONS.md.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Par-cook the carrots and potatoes 5 minutes until fork tender, then blanch the peas and beans about a minute in the same pot. Strain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the vegetables and warm through.
Add the milk and cream and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and season with salt and pepper.
Add the dill and chives and simmer at least 10 minutes. Serve warm.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until very tender. Drain, mash with some of the butter, then purée with the milk. Season and set aside.
Preheat the oven to 190C/375F.
Brown the onion in the remaining butter in a large skillet. Add the beef and cook until browned. Season.
Press the meat into the bottom of a baking dish. Cover with the creamed corn, then the mashed potatoes. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
Bake about 30 minutes, finishing under the broiler. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

name: Paella

ingredients.preparation: short-grain paella rice; no dedicated ontology entry, using white rice as a stand-in

tools: paella pan or large wide skillet

steps.text: Simmer prawn heads with sherry and water to make a stock, then infuse with saffron.
Cook the mussels in the pan and strain their juices into the saffron stock.
Sauté the chorizo, onion, and garlic, then add the squid, tomatoes, and most of the stock.
Scatter the rice over and boil vigorously for 5 minutes, then reduce the heat.
Nestle the prawn tails into the rice and simmer 5 minutes, then add the mussels and broad beans, adjusting liquid as needed.
Rest the pan covered, garnish with parsley and lemon zest, season, and serve directly from the pan with lemon wedges.

name: Chicken & Chorizo Rice Pot
tools: large flameproof casserole dish with lid

steps.text: Heat the oil in the casserole dish and brown the chicken pieces on all sides, in batches if needed. Remove and set aside.
Lower the heat, add the onion and pepper, and cook gently 10 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and chorizo and cook 2 minutes until the chorizo releases its oils.
Stir in the tomato purée and cook 1 minute more.
Return the chicken to the dish with the thyme, white wine, and stock. Bring to a boil, cover, and lower the heat. Cook 30 minutes.
Stir in the rice, cover, and cook on low a further 15 minutes until the rice is cooked and has absorbed most of the liquid.
Remove from heat and rest 10 minutes. Season to taste and scatter with parsley to serve.

note: Uses white wine — see DECISIONS.md on alcohol no longer being excluded.

ingredients.preparation: 3 tbsp for sauce, 2 tbsp for roasting

steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry the onion 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, tomato purée, paprika, chilli powder, sugar, and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally.
Simmer 10 minutes until pulpy. Can be chilled up to 24 hours ahead.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Pat the potatoes dry and toss in a roasting tin with the remaining oil and seasoning.
Roast 40-50 minutes until crisp and golden.
Transfer to serving dishes, spoon the tomato sauce over the top, and garnish with parsley.
Mix the lemon juice with the paprika and red onions in a large shallow dish.
Slash each chicken thigh three times, then turn them in the juice and set aside 10 minutes.
Mix all the remaining marinade ingredients together and pour over the chicken. Mix well, cover, and chill at least 1 hour (up to a day).
Heat the grill. Lift the chicken onto a rack over a baking tray.
Brush with a little oil and grill 8 minutes on each side, or until lightly charred and cooked through.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat. Add the paneer and turn the heat down slightly. Fry until browned on each side, then remove and drain.
Add the ginger, cumin, turmeric, coriander, and chilli to the pan and fry 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, mashing them with the back of a spoon, and simmer 5 minutes until fragrant. Add a splash of water if too thick. Season.
Add the peas and simmer a further 2 minutes, then stir in the paneer and sprinkle over the garam masala.
Top with coriander leaves and serve with naan, roti, or rice.

ingredients.preparation: small, split; source used naan as a bun substitute
soured cream and chive dip; sour cream used as base

steps.text: Tip the meat into a bowl, sprinkle over the salt and pepper, and mix in with wet hands.
Divide into four and shape into burgers.
Heat a griddle pan or barbecue. Toast the split naan on both sides until lightly coloured.
Cook the burgers 2-3 minutes per side.
Set half a toasted naan on each plate, pile on the rocket, top with a burger, then beetroot slices and a dollop of soured cream and chive dip. Season and serve.

ingredients.preparation: Romano peppers; using bell pepper as a documented stand-in
pul biber; using red pepper flakes as a documented stand-in

steps.text: Finely chop the peppers in a food processor, then press them in a sieve to release their juices.
Combine the peppers, lamb mince, red pepper paste, pul biber, salt, and 2 tbsp of the oil in a bowl. Knead well for 2-3 minutes until sticky.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours, up to 12 hours.
Heat the grill to high or the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 6. Divide the mixture into 12 portions (or 8 for skewers) and shape into köfte.
Brush with the remaining oil and cook under the grill 10-12 minutes, turning regularly, or in the oven 16-18 minutes, until crispy outside and juicy inside.

ingredients.preparation: 2 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Rinse the fish and rub with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the fish 5-7 minutes per side until crispy. Remove and drain, leaving 2-3 tbsp oil in the pan.
Stir-fry the bay leaf, garlic, and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the onion, peppers, carrot, thyme, scotch bonnet, sugar, and allspice, and cook 2-3 minutes.
Add the vinegar and Worcestershire sauce, adjust seasoning, and simmer 2 more minutes.
Discard the bay leaf and thyme sprigs, and spoon the mixture over the fish to serve.
Heat the oil in a non-stick wok. Add the broccoli and fry on high heat 5 minutes until just tender, adding a little water if it starts to catch.
Add the garlic and chilli and fry 1 minute.
Toss through the spring onions, soya beans, pak choi, and tofu. Stir-fry 2-3 minutes.
Add the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, and cashews and warm through.

ingredients.preparation: tomato soup, tomato juice, and ketchup mix approximated as crushed tomatoes

steps.text: Boil lightly salted water and place the cabbage head in, covered, for 3 minutes until the leaves soften. Cool 10 minutes.
Extract 18 whole leaves, removing the thick center ribs. Chop the remaining cabbage and spread in a casserole dish.
Melt the butter in a skillet and cook the onion until tender, 5-10 minutes. Cool.
Combine the onion, beef, pork, rice, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Preheat the oven to 350F. Place about 1/2 cup of the meat mixture on each cabbage leaf, roll tightly tucking in the sides, and arrange over the chopped cabbage.
Season with salt and pepper. Mix the crushed tomatoes and ketchup and pour over the rolls. Cover with foil.
Bake about 1 hour until the cabbage is tender and the meat is fully cooked.
Combine the sake, soy sauce, sesame oil, and cornflour dissolved in water. Divide the mixture in half.
Combine half the mixture with the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes.
In a frying pan, combine the remaining sake mixture with the chilli powder, vinegar, and sugar. Add the spring onion, garlic, water chestnuts, and peanuts. Heat slowly until aromatic.
Meanwhile, remove the chicken from the marinade and sauté in a separate pan until the juices run clear.
Add the sautéed chicken to the sauce and simmer together until the sauce thickens.

ingredients.preparation: 1/2 tsp white pepper, using black pepper as a stand-in
1 tbsp for gravy, 1 tbsp for batter
for deep frying; recorded at reduced volume vs. the 3 cups stated, matching the fried-oil-absorption convention used elsewhere in this project

steps.text: Make the gravy: combine the beef stock, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, oyster sauce, and white pepper in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened, 2-3 minutes. Keep warm.
Make the batter: whisk the remaining cornstarch with water, then whisk in the eggs, salt, and sugar.
Add the green onion, bean sprouts, and shrimp to the batter and stir until coated.
Heat the oil in a wok to 350F. Ladle in a quarter of the batter at a time and fry until golden and crispy, about 2 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels, repeat with the remaining batter, and serve over rice with the warm gravy spooned over the top.

ingredients.preparation: half an egg, for the marinade
lo mein noodles; using egg noodles as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Marinate the beef: combine the beef, salt, pepper, sesame oil, egg, and cornstarch in a bowl with 1 tbsp of the oil and mix well.
Boil the noodles in a large pot for about 10 seconds, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Stir-fry: heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok, add the beef, and cook on high heat until medium done. Set aside.
In the wok, add the remaining oil, onion, garlic, ginger, bean sprouts, and mushrooms with about 1.5 cups water and simmer until the vegetables are just covered.
Add the noodles to the wok. Mix the oyster sauce, remaining pepper, sesame oil, sugar, and soy sauce, and stir in.
Add the beef back to the wok and stir-fry everything together.

ingredients.preparation: rashers; using per-slice bacon weight, chopped
fresh basil leaves to top, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pan. Chop and cook the bacon until golden.
Add the onion, celery, and carrot and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, cook 1 minute, then add the minced beef, stirring and breaking it apart, for about 6 minutes until browned.
Stir in the tomato puree for 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes plus a half-can of water per can, season with honey, and adjust seasoning. Simmer 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Layer the ragu on the bottom of a baking dish, top with overlapping lasagne sheets, and repeat the sauce/pasta layers twice more, finishing with pasta.
Mix the creme fraiche with 2 tbsp water until pourable, pour over the pasta, and top with mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling. Finish with fresh basil if desired.

ingredients.preparation: small bunch fresh sage, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Put the squash and garlic on a baking tray, drizzle with olive oil, and roast 35-40 minutes until soft. Season.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions. Drain, reserving the cooking water.
Blend the roasted squash with 400ml of the reserved cooking water until smooth.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan and fry the sage until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Toss the pasta and sauce together in the pan and warm through. Scatter with the crispy sage.

ingredients.preparation: juice of 3, plus 2 for wedges to serve

steps.text: Put the noodles in a large heatproof bowl, pour boiling water over them, and leave 4 minutes. Drain and refresh under cold water.
Mix the lime juice, cayenne, sugar, and fish sauce together.
Heat the oil and fry the prawns until warmed through. Add the spring onions and noodles and toss.
Add the lime juice mixture, then stir in the bean sprouts and half the peanuts and coriander. Cook 1 minute until heated through.
Plate, garnish with the remaining peanuts and coriander, and serve with lime wedges and sweet chilli sauce.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce with the orange zest and juice, garlic, curry paste, and salt.
Add the chicken and coat well.
Arrange the drumsticks on the foil, spaced apart, coating with any remaining marinade.
Roast 35-40 minutes until tender.

name: Beef Bourguignon

ingredients.preparation: bouquet garni + fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent
fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches using the goose fat, then set aside.
Fry the bacon, shallots, mushrooms, garlic, and bouquet garni until lightly browned.
Add the tomato puree, cook briefly, then return the beef with its juices.
Pour in the wine and water to nearly cover the meat, scraping up any caramelized bits from the pan.
Cover and braise at 150C/fan 130C/gas 2 for 3 hours. If the sauce is watery, reduce it separately over high heat before returning the meat.
For the celeriac mash: cube and fry the celeriac in olive oil 5 minutes until golden. Season, add the herbs, pour in 200ml water, and simmer 25-30 minutes until soft.
Drain, remove the herbs, lightly crush, and finish with olive oil. Serve the bourguignon in bowls topped with the celeriac mash.

note: Uses red wine — see DECISIONS.md on alcohol no longer being excluded.

name: Chicken Parmentier

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender. Drain and rice or mash thoroughly.
Combine the mashed potato with butter, cream, and egg yolks, and season.
Sauté the shallots, carrots, and celery in butter until soft, add the garlic, then the wine, and cook briefly.
Stir in the tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, and stock, and cook 10-15 minutes until thickened.
Mix in the shredded chicken, olives, and parsley.
Layer the filling in a baking dish, top with the potato mixture and cheese.
Bake at 180C for 30-35 minutes until piping hot and the potato is golden-brown.

note: Uses white wine — see DECISIONS.md on alcohol no longer being excluded.

ingredients.preparation: recipe calls for ~400g; using 3 standard 142g cans (426g)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Toss the potatoes with oil and seasoning, spread on a baking tray, and roast about 20 minutes until golden and tender, stirring halfway.
Boil the eggs 8-10 minutes, then cool in cold water, peel, and halve.
Whisk together the remaining oil, vinegar, and capers with seasoning in a large bowl.
Add the onion, spinach, tuna, and roasted potatoes, and gently combine.
Top with the eggs and serve immediately.

ingredients.preparation: 1 tbsp chopped, plus the tarragon leaves this recipe called for — no close ontology match for tarragon, folded in as extra parsley

steps.text: Warm a 20cm non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Crack the eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork until just mixed.
Add the butter and eggs to the pan, stirring gently from the sides while cooking.
Once partially set, stir faster, leaving some barely-cooked egg.
Settle the mixture by shaking the pan, then brown the underside.
Scatter over the cheese and herbs, tilt and fold the omelette onto a plate, glaze with butter, and serve immediately.

name: Gambas al Ajillo
tools: flameproof terracotta pot or frying pan

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails intact, and season with sea salt.
Put the garlic, olive oil, and chillies in a flameproof pot or frying pan over high heat.
When the garlic turns golden, add the prawns and cook 1-2 minutes per side until pink.
Sprinkle with parsley and black pepper, and serve immediately.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Fry the onion, chorizo, and peppers in the oil with salt and pepper for 15 minutes until softened and the chorizo has released its oils.
Add the paprika and garlic, and cook a few minutes until fragrant.
Tip in the tomatoes, olives, and butter beans, stir to combine, and season.
Nestle in the chicken thighs and season well.
Transfer to the oven and bake 40 minutes until the chicken is crisp and cooked through.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

name: Pisto con Huevos

ingredients.preparation: fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent

tools: large flameproof casserole dish or cast-iron skillet

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large flameproof casserole dish over low heat. Add the onions and a pinch of salt, cover, and cook gently 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic and cook 2 minutes more.
Add the peppers and cook over medium heat, covered, about 5 minutes until just tender.
Mix in the oregano, thyme, bay leaves, and seasoning.
Add the courgettes and aubergine, combine, and cook covered over medium heat 10 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, cover, and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Crack the eggs over the pisto, trying not to break the yolks. Cook 5-6 minutes until the eggs are cooked through but still soft.
Scatter with parsley before serving.

ingredients.preparation: fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Put the tomatoes in a bowl with the onion and thyme. Season, then drizzle with vinegar and oil. Let the flavours mingle while cooking the chorizo.
In a hot, dry pan, fry the chorizo slices until browned on both sides.
Serve the tomatoes with the fried chorizo, drizzled with a little oil from the pan.
Tip the mince into a large bowl with the onion, garlic, garam masala, coriander, chilli sauce, and a pinch of salt. Mix thoroughly by hand.
Pat the mix into 16 small burgers. May be frozen up to 1 month or chilled up to a day ahead.
Heat the grill to its highest setting and lay the burgers in a single layer on a baking tray.
Grill on the highest shelf 5-6 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Pile onto a platter and serve with the pita, tomato, cabbage, red onion, and yogurt.
Cut the chicken into 3cm pieces. Add the oil, spices, garlic, and vinegar, toss well, and season.
Thread 2-3 pieces onto each skewer.
Heat oil in a frying pan or griddle and sear the chicken 3-4 minutes per side, working in batches.
Serve with the aioli.

ingredients.preparation: vermicelli pasta; using egg noodles as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold running water until the water runs clear, then soak in cold water 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a medium pan, add the vermicelli, and stir 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Remove from heat, mix in the butter, and cool briefly.
Drain the rice and add it to the pan, stirring well.
Pour in the hot stock, season with salt, stir, and bring to a boil. Reduce to the lowest heat, cover, and simmer 7-9 minutes.
Remove from heat, cover with kitchen paper and the lid, and let sit 10 minutes before fluffing with a fork.

ingredients.preparation: juice of half a lemon, estimated
8 lamb loin chops; using lamb-leg as the closest ontology match, ~150g/chop

steps.text: Put the garlic in a bowl with the ginger, lemon juice, oil, spices, and seasoning. Blitz until smooth.
Coat the lamb chops on both sides with the marinade. Chill 2 hours to overnight.
Heat a barbecue until hot. Barbecue the chops 3 minutes per side until cooked but still pink and juicy in the centre.

name: Poutine
tools: deep fryer or deep heavy skillet

steps.text: Heat the oil in a deep fryer or heavy skillet to 365F (185C).
Warm the gravy in a saucepan or microwave.
Fry the potatoes in the hot oil until light brown, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Place the fries on a serving platter, sprinkle with the cheese curds, and ladle the gravy over the top. Serve immediately.
Soak the dried beans overnight in a Dutch oven with plenty of water.
Drain and cover the beans with fresh water. Cook 30 minutes until tender but still firm, reserving the cooking water.
Heat the oven to 325F (160C). Brown the bacon in the Dutch oven over medium-high heat, then add the onion until softened.
Return the beans to the pot with the molasses, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard, salt, pepper, and 3 cups of the reserved bean water.
Bake uncovered 3-5 hours until the beans are tender and the sauce has thickened, adding water as needed to prevent drying out.

ingredients.preparation: salt beef; using beef-brisket as the closest ontology match, 2 lbs

steps.text: The night before, break the salt beef into chunks and soak in water overnight. Soak the split peas separately, covered in water.
Drain and place the beef in a large stockpot with fresh water. Enclose the split peas in cheesecloth and tie inside the pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 2 hours.
Remove the peas, mix with butter and pepper, and set aside.
Add the cabbage and boil 20 minutes. Then add the turnip, carrots, and potatoes, and boil another 20 minutes until tender.
Remove the beef and vegetables and arrange on a platter. The cooking liquid can be served as broth or reduced into a gravy.

ingredients.preparation: 3 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Combine the chicken with the seasonings, curry powder, aromatics, scotch bonnet, and thyme in a bowl. Marinate refrigerated at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Remove the solids from the chicken before cooking.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot, toast the remaining curry powder briefly, then sauté the aromatics until softened.
Add the chicken with water, cover, and simmer on medium-low 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
With about 15 minutes remaining, add the potato.
Once the chicken is tender and the potatoes are soft, adjust seasoning with salt and pepper.

ingredients.preparation: 1 tsp for the dough, 1/4 tsp for the filling

steps.text: Make the pastry dough: combine the flour, salt, curry powder, and turmeric, then work in the butter until crumbly. Add water gradually to form a dough. Chill.
Make the filling: brown the beef with the allspice, pepper, and oil. Add the onions, chilli, garlic, and thyme, and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the ketchup and water, and simmer until thick. Season with the remaining salt.
Roll out the dough and cut into circles. Fill each with the beef mixture, fold into half-moons, and crimp the edges.
Refrigerate the assembled patties, brush with the egg wash, then bake at 350F for 30 minutes until golden.
Cool slightly and serve warm.
Cook the noodles per package instructions, then rinse under cold water and drain.
In a small saucepan, melt together the peanut butter, coconut milk, sweet chilli sauce, and half the spring onions, loosening with 1-2 tbsp water to a drizzling consistency.
Mix the noodles, cucumber, and bean sprouts in a serving dish.
Top with the prawns, drizzle over the peanut sauce, and scatter with the remaining spring onions.

ingredients.preparation: sunflower oil, for frying; recorded at a reduced volume vs. what deep frying would call for, matching the fried-oil-absorption convention used elsewhere

steps.text: Combine the dipping sauce ingredients (rice vinegar, sugar, fish sauce, red onion) in a bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Mix the cornflour, plain flour, both peppers, and 2 tsp sea salt in a separate bowl.
Heat 7cm of oil to 180C in a deep fryer or wok.
Coat the squid thoroughly in the flour mixture and fry in batches, about 2 minutes each, until crispy.
Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with additional salt.
Serve scattered with spring onion and chilli, alongside the dipping sauce.

name: Vietnamese Grilled Pork (Bun Thit Nuong)

steps.text: Slice the pork thinly, about 1/8 inch. Mince the garlic and shallots.
Mix the pork with the garlic, shallots, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, pepper, and oil until the sugar dissolves. Marinate 1 hour, or overnight.
Bake the pork at 375F for 10-15 minutes until about 80% cooked.
Finish under the broiler until golden brown, flipping halfway.
Assemble bowls with the noodles, cucumber, pork, mint, and crushed peanuts.

note: Source recipe also called for pre-made egg rolls as a side accompaniment — omitted as a store-bought item with no clean ontology fit rather than the recipe's core content.

steps.text: Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Mince the garlic into a wok with the oil. Heat until hot, add the chicken and broccoli stems, and cook until the chicken is light golden.
Push to the side of the wok, crack the egg in, and scramble.
Add the noodles, broccoli leaves, and sauce. Gently mix until the noodles are stained dark and the leaves are wilted. Serve immediately.

name: Thai Chicken Cakes with Sweet Chilli Sauce

steps.text: Put the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, coriander, and chilli into a food processor and season well. Blitz until finely ground and well mixed.
Shape into six small cakes with your hands.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the cakes over medium heat 6-8 minutes, turning once.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce, lime wedges, coriander, and shredded spring onion.

ingredients.preparation: juice of 1, plus lime to serve

steps.text: Grind the chilli, garlic, coriander stalks, and sugar together, then mix with the lime juice and fish sauce. Marinate the prawns in this mixture.
Heat the oil in a wok, then cook the ginger and spring onions briefly.
Add the red pepper, water chestnuts, and bean sprouts and cook until the sprouts soften.
Season with soy sauce and black pepper, then transfer the vegetable mixture to a serving dish.
Cook the prawns in the remaining oil until pink, add the marinade, then combine with the vegetables.
Top with fresh coriander and lime juice, and serve over noodles.
Heat a wok or large frying pan until smoking hot.
Pour in the oil, then add the beef strips and chilli. Cook, stirring, until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
Pour over the oyster sauce and cook until heated through and the sauce coats the meat.
Stir in the basil leaves and serve with plain rice.

ingredients.preparation: 2 tbsp for sauerkraut filling, 3 tbsp for potato filling
1/3 cup + 1/2 cup chopped, ~5/6 of an onion

steps.text: For the sauerkraut filling: melt butter in a skillet, cook the onion until translucent, then add the sauerkraut and cook 5 more minutes. Season and cool.
For the potato filling: melt butter, cook the onion until translucent, then stir into the mashed potatoes and season.
For the dough: beat the eggs and sour cream until smooth. Sift in the flour, salt, and baking powder, and stir until a dough forms. Knead until firm and smooth.
Divide the dough in half. Roll out to 1/8 inch thickness and cut into 3-inch rounds.
Fill each round with a spoonful of filling, moisten the edges, fold over, and press to seal with a fork. Repeat with both fillings.
Boil in salted water 3-5 minutes until the pierogi float to the top. Remove with a slotted spoon.
Soften the bread roll in the milk.
Fry the onion in a little of the oil 8 minutes until soft and golden.
Combine the fried onion with the beef mince, egg, garlic, marjoram, and seasoning.
Squeeze the excess milk from the bread and add it to the mince mixture. Mix well and season.
Form 8 patties and coat in the breadcrumbs.
Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan and fry the patties in batches, about 6-7 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Preheat the oven to 350F (175C). Cook the bacon and kielbasa in a large pot until the bacon renders and the sausage browns. Transfer to a casserole dish.
Coat the pork cubes in flour and fry in the bacon drippings until golden brown. Transfer to the casserole.
Add the garlic, onion, mushrooms, cabbage, and sauerkraut to the pot. Cook and stir over medium heat about 10 minutes without browning.
Deglaze with the red wine, scraping up the browned bits.
Season with the bay leaf, basil, marjoram, paprika, caraway seed, salt, pepper, and hot sauce. Cook 1 minute.
Mix in the Worcestershire sauce, beef stock, tomato paste, and diced tomatoes. Heat until just boiling.
Pour the vegetables and liquid into the casserole with the meat, cover, and bake 2.5-3 hours until the meat is very tender.
Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bake the baguettes on a tray 8-10 minutes, then let cool.
Cook the chopped onion with the butter and oil until soft, add the mushrooms and cook 5-10 minutes, stir in the garlic and mayonnaise, and season.
Halve the baguettes lengthways and return to the tray cut-side up. Spread over the mushroom mixture, then sprinkle with the cheddar, ham, kielbasa, and mozzarella.
Bake 8-10 minutes until the cheese has melted and turned golden.
Fry the remaining sliced onion until golden. Top the baked baguettes with the caramelized onion, dill pickles, chives, and a drizzle of ketchup.
Roast the eggplant over an open flame until completely tender, then cool in water. Peel and finely chop or mash.
Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the green chilli, then the tomatoes, and cook until the oil separates from the mixture.
Season with chilli powder, then stir in the mashed eggplant.
Cook 4-5 minutes, adjusting salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rotis, chapatis, or rice.

ingredients.preparation: dried fenugreek leaves, estimated as ground equivalent

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot. Add the sliced onion and fry until deep golden brown.
Sauté the garlic, tomatoes, and ginger.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, chilli powder, and green chilli, then the chicken. Cover and cook on medium-low about 15 minutes.
Once the oil separates from the spices, fold in the beaten yogurt at the lowest heat.
Add the dried fenugreek leaves, then finish with the cream, remaining herbs, and garam masala.
Serve with naan or rotis.
Grind the cashews, poppy seeds, and half the cumin seeds into a smooth paste with a little water.
Deep fry the onions until light brown, then fry the cashews until golden. Soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Sauté the onions with the paste, remaining cumin seeds, ginger-garlic paste, and garlic.
Add the tomatoes and cook thoroughly.
Mix in the spices, herbs, yogurt, lamb, salt, and water. Cook covered 1 hour, or pressure cook.
Boil the rice separately until 80% cooked, then drain.
Layer the lamb with the rice, garnish with the fried onions, ghee, herbs, and saffron milk.
Bake at 350F for 15 minutes, or cook stovetop at medium heat 12 minutes then lowest heat 5 minutes. Mix and serve hot.
Cook the potato in boiling water 8-10 minutes until tender. Drain and let steam-dry.
Heat the oil in an omelette pan, add the chorizo, and cook 2 minutes.
Add the potato and cook a further 5 minutes until it starts to crisp. Remove from the pan.
Wipe the pan and cook a 3-egg omelette in it.
When almost cooked, scatter over the chorizo, potato, parsley, and cheese. Fold and cook 1 minute more to melt the cheese.

ingredients.preparation: for frying; recorded at a reduced volume vs. the full deep-fry depth called for, matching the fried-oil-absorption convention used elsewhere

steps.text: Cut the squid into rings about 1/2cm thick.
Season the flour in a freezer bag, add the capers, and shake to mix. Add the squid and shake to coat.
Mix the garlic and mayonnaise and place in a serving bowl.
Heat the oil to about 7cm depth in a large pan.
Shake off excess flour from the squid, then fry in batches about 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on kitchen paper.
Serve immediately with the mayonnaise and lemon wedges.

ingredients.preparation: 3 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pan and gently fry the onion 3-4 minutes until softening.
Stir in the carrot, celery, thyme, and bay leaves. Season and cook 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic, chorizo, cinnamon, and smoked paprika. Fry gently until the vegetables soften and the chorizo crisps.
Stir in the chickpeas, vinegar, and 150ml water, then simmer 1-2 minutes until the chickpeas are heated through.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Season to taste and serve warm with crusty bread.

ingredients.preparation: pinto beans substituted; both dried legumes needing an overnight soak
fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent
250g Jersey Royal potatoes, using potato-russet as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Soak the beans at least 4 hours or overnight in plenty of water.
Rinse and drain, then put in a large pan with the onion, paprika, herbs, and chicken. Cover with water or stock, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 45 minutes.
Remove the chicken to a plate, then add the potatoes and chorizo. Continue cooking 30 minutes until the beans and potatoes are tender.
Discard the chicken skin and bones and tear the meat into chunks. Return to the pan with the spinach and simmer 5 minutes.

ingredients.preparation: 2 tbsp for marinade, 2 tbsp for slurry
1 tsp, plus 1/2 tsp onion salt approximated as extra salt
for deep frying; recorded at a reduced volume, matching the fried-oil-absorption convention used elsewhere

steps.text: Combine the water, soy sauce, vinegar, and seasonings to make the sauce.
Marinate the chicken with salt, pepper, egg, and cornstarch.
Deep fry at 350F for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Stir-fry with the sauce, thickening with a cornstarch slurry, and finish with the chicken.
Mix the cornstarch, sherry, and salt for the marinade. Add the shrimp and let sit 15-20 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the ginger and garlic 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp with its marinade, the snow peas, soy sauce, and chicken stock. Cook until the shrimp turns pink, about 2 minutes.
Add the scallions and stir-fry 1 minute more.
Remove from heat, drizzle with sesame oil, toss, and serve with steamed rice.
Bring water to a boil, gently add the egg, and cook 6.5-7 minutes.
Immediately transfer to ice water for 3-5 minutes.
Cook the noodles per package instructions.
Peel the egg. Combine the noodles with soy sauce, chilli sauce, spring onion, salt, and pepper.
Slice the egg in half and serve on top, letting the yolk flow into the broth.

ingredients.preparation: 1 tbsp for sauce, remainder for dredging
for deep frying; recorded at a reduced volume, matching the fried-oil-absorption convention used elsewhere

steps.text: Whisk together the orange zest, orange juice, soy sauce, water, rice vinegar, cornstarch, sesame oil, and sugar for the sauce. Set aside.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch cubes. Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, and add the chicken.
Dredge the chicken in the cornstarch and flour, then fry at 350F for 6-8 minutes total until golden.
Sauté the garlic and shallots, then add the sauce and simmer until thickened. Toss in the fried chicken.
Serve over rice, garnished with sesame seeds and scallions.

name: Coq au Vin

ingredients.preparation: 3 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent
2 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent

tools: large heavy-based saucepan or flameproof dish

steps.text: Heat some oil in a large saucepan, fry the bacon until crisp, remove and drain.
Fry the shallots until well browned, remove and set aside with the bacon.
Fry the chicken pieces in batches until well browned. Remove and set aside.
Fry the garlic briefly, then deglaze with the brandy, letting the alcohol sizzle and mostly evaporate.
Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the wine, stock, and tomato purée, add the herbs, and season. Return the bacon and shallots.
Cover, lower to a gentle simmer, and cook 50 minutes to 1 hour.
Fry the mushrooms in a separate pan until golden.
Lift the chicken, shallots, and bacon to a serving dish. Mix the flour, oil, and butter into a paste and whisk into the simmering sauce to thicken. Simmer 1-2 minutes.
Scatter the mushrooms over the chicken, pour over the sauce, and garnish with parsley.

note: Uses red wine and brandy — see DECISIONS.md on alcohol no longer being excluded.

ingredients.preparation: fresh sprigs, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6.
Fry the onions and thyme in the oil until softened and lightly coloured, about 5 minutes.
Layer the potatoes and onions in an oiled gratin dish, finishing with a layer of potatoes.
Pour over the stock and bake 50-60 minutes until the potatoes are cooked and the top is golden and crisp.

name: Steak Diane

steps.text: Heat the oil in a skillet, season the steaks, and cook 4-5 minutes for medium-rare. Set aside.
Add the stock to the skillet and reduce to about 1.5 cups, about 10 minutes. Set aside.
Add the butter to the skillet, then the garlic and shallots, and cook until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release liquid and begin to brown.
Add the brandy and carefully flambée, cooking until the flame dies down.
Stir in the reserved stock, cream, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce. Return the steaks to the pan and cook until warmed through and the sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.
Stir the parsley and chives into the sauce and pour over the steaks to serve.

note: Uses brandy — see DECISIONS.md on alcohol no longer being excluded.

ingredients.preparation: 1 tsp dried summer savoury, using thyme as the closest ontology match
1/2 tsp ground nutmeg, plus 1/2 tsp ground clove folded in with it
shortcrust pastry substituted; 4 sheets/discs for a top and bottom crust across 2 pies

steps.text: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef, pork, and spices, and brown the meat.
Pour in the beef broth and simmer, then reduce to medium-low.
Stir in the grated potato and cook until the liquid is nearly absorbed, about 15 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf, season with salt, and cool completely.
Preheat the oven to 375F (190C). Line a 9-inch pie plate with one pastry disc and fill with the cooled mixture.
Top with the remaining pastry, cut a steam hole, trim and pinch the edges together, and brush with egg wash.
Bake 45 minutes until golden brown. Cool 15 minutes before serving.

ingredients.preparation: 1 tbsp celery salt, using plain salt as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Mix the cure blend and rub over the brisket. Refrigerate 4 days, flipping regularly.
Rinse and soak the meat, then apply the spice rub.
Smoke at 225F until the internal temperature reaches 165F, about 6 hours.
Steam in a roasting pan over the stovetop until the meat reaches 180F, 1-2 hours.
Slice and serve on rye bread with mustard.
Preheat the oven to 400F (200C) and grease a baking pan.
Cook the onion in butter until softened, then continue cooking on low until very tender and dark brown, about 45 minutes total.
Bring the chicken broth to a boil, add the chicken, reduce heat, and simmer until cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove the chicken and reserve the broth.
Juice the potatoes, discarding the liquid. Stir salt and pepper into the potato flesh, then stir in enough reserved broth to reach an oatmeal-like consistency.
Spread half the potato mixture in the pan. Lay the chicken over it and scatter the caramelized onion on top.
Cover with the remaining potato mixture. Bake until golden brown, about 1 hour.
Reheat the remaining chicken broth and pour over individual servings.
Bake the potatoes until tender, about 1 hour at 200C, then slice open lengthwise.
Mash plenty of butter into the hot potato flesh, followed by the cheese, until melted and creamy.
Stir in the chopped onion and red pepper, season with salt, pepper, and chilli flakes.
Pile the mixture back into the potato skins and serve, customizing with toppings like sweetcorn, olives, or coleslaw if desired.
Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a pan and soften the onions for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices and cook a few minutes more.
Reserve half the onion mixture to cool separately. Combine the tomatoes, sugar, and seasoning with the remaining onions and simmer about 10 minutes until thickened.
Blend the cooled onion mixture with the mint, lamb mince, apricots, and breadcrumbs. Season and form into small meatballs.
Fry the meatballs until golden, in batches if needed. Stir into the sauce with a splash of water and gently cook a few minutes until cooked through.
Serve with pita bread and salad.

ingredients.preparation: 1/2 lime for the marinade plus juice of 1 lime, combined
red chilli substituted with jalapeño as the closest ontology match
1/2 tsp dried thyme for marinade plus 2 sprigs fresh for rice, combined

steps.text: Blend the jerk marinade ingredients with salt into a thick paste. Adjust seasoning to balance salt, spice, and sweetness.
Score the chicken thighs and coat thoroughly with the marinade. Refrigerate overnight.
Barbecue over indirect heat with wood chips for 30 minutes, or bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Meanwhile, rinse the rice and simmer with all rice ingredients except the beans, plus 300ml water, for 10 minutes.
Add the beans, cover, and rest 5 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Squeeze roasted lime over the chicken and serve with the rice and peas.

ingredients.preparation: goat meat substituted with lamb-leg as the closest ontology match; 3 lbs
3 sprigs fresh, estimated as dried equivalent
to taste, plus 1/2 tsp all-purpose seasoning folded in as extra salt

steps.text: Rinse the meat, then season with curry powder, ginger, allspice, onion, garlic, and thyme. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight, reserving the onion and garlic.
Brown the meat in oil in a pressure cooker on high sauté, 2-3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Sauté the remaining curry powder briefly, then the reserved onion and garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Return the meat to the cooker with the water and seal. Cook on high pressure 40 minutes, then release naturally 10 minutes before releasing the rest.
Open the cooker and sauté 10-15 minutes. Add the potato and scotch bonnet, cook until the potato softens, then remove the pepper.
Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve.

ingredients.preparation: 1 cinnamon stick substituted with ground cinnamon equivalent
coriander seeds substituted with ground coriander
palm sugar substituted with brown sugar
bird's-eye chilli substituted with jalapeño as the closest ontology match, small

steps.text: Combine the beef stock with water in a saucepan. Char the onion and ginger in a frying pan over high heat 3-5 minutes, then add to the stock.
Toast the spices 2-3 minutes until fragrant and add to the stock. Simmer 30 minutes, then strain.
Wrap the steak in plastic film and freeze 15 minutes, then slice thinly and refrigerate.
Season the strained stock with sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce.
Prepare the noodles per package directions and divide between bowls. Top with sliced beef, pour over boiling stock, and garnish with spring onions, chilli, and herbs. Serve with lime wedges.

ingredients.preparation: pork shoulder steaks; using pork-chop-boneless as the closest ontology match
red chilli substituted with jalapeño as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork in batches until browned all over. Remove and set aside.
Turn the heat down, add the remaining oil, and stir in the shallots, ginger, and chilli. Cook a couple of minutes until softening.
Add the sugar, fish sauce, and 200ml water. Bring to a boil, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Return the pork to the pan and bubble vigorously 8-10 minutes until the sauce thickens and turns glossy. Stir in the chilli sauce.
Sprinkle with spring onions and serve with steamed rice and pak choi.
Combine the flour, eggs, milk, water, and salt in a bowl. Mix with a hand mixer until smooth and lump-free.
Incorporate the butter into the batter, or use it to coat the pan before cooking each pancake.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in batter, and tilt to distribute evenly.
Once the pancake separates from the pan edges and the surface dries, flip and briefly cook the other side.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve warm with your preferred filling.

ingredients.preparation: pork shoulder; using pork-chop-boneless as the closest ontology match
white sauerkraut, with a little pickling juice

steps.text: Heat the lard in a saucepan and fry the onion until golden, 5-8 minutes. Add the cumin and pork and fry 10 minutes until browned all over.
Add the garlic, season, and scatter over the flour. Cook about a minute, then add the paprika and cook 1 minute more.
Pour in half the stock, add the bay leaves, and simmer covered on low heat 30 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, remaining stock, and a drizzle of pickling juice. Simmer covered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender.
Stir in the cream and simmer 5 minutes to combine. Season to taste and serve garnished with soured cream.

ingredients.preparation: arborio rice substituted with rice-white as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Melt the butter in a thick-based pan and gently cook the onion until soft.
Stir in the rice to coat all grains with butter, then add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Gradually incorporate the hot stock, stirring continuously, until the rice is tender.
Season with the lemon juice, zest, and pepper to taste.
Grill the salmon, then place onto the risotto along with the prawns and asparagus.
Serve scattered with Parmesan shavings.

ingredients.preparation: roughly chopped; reserve fronds to garnish
1 sliced for sauce, 1 crushed for pesto
rigatoni; using pasta-other-dry as the closest ontology match
pecorino substituted with parmesan-grated as the closest ontology match
1 anchovy fillet substituted with a small amount of sardines as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large saute pan and fry the sausage pieces on medium-high heat 10 minutes until golden-brown all over. Transfer to a plate.
Cook the onion and fennel in the pan 15 minutes until caramelized. Add the paprika, garlic, and half the fennel seeds, fry 2 minutes.
Add the wine and boil briefly, then add the tomatoes, sugar, water, sausage, and salt. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, removing the lid after 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the olives and remaining fennel seeds.
Cook the rigatoni 12-14 minutes until al dente. Reheat the sauce, drain the pasta, toss with a little oil, then divide into bowls.
Blitz the pesto ingredients (garlic, anchovy/sardine, oil, parmesan) with a tablespoon of water into a rough paste, then add the basil and blitz until just combined.
Spoon the sauce over the pasta, top with pesto, garnish with fennel fronds, and serve immediately.

ingredients.preparation: British sausages substituted with sausage-italian as the closest ontology match
semi-skimmed milk approximated with whole milk

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200C/fan 180C/gas 6. Fry the sausages in a non-stick pan until browned.
Heat the oil in a roasting tray (30x25x6cm) for 5 minutes.
Combine the flour, eggs, and horseradish in a bowl, then gradually whisk in the milk and season.
Put the sausages into the hot roasting tray and pour over the batter. Top with the cherry tomatoes and cook 30 minutes until puffed and golden.

ingredients.preparation: semi-skimmed milk approximated with whole milk
Jerusalem artichokes substituted with turnip as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 minutes until tender. Drain and mash with olive oil, then season.
Heat the milk in a sauté pan, add the fish, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, cover 3 minutes, then flake into an ovenproof dish, discarding skin and bones.
Heat the remaining oil, stir in the flour for 30 seconds, then gradually add 200-250ml of the reserved milk. Grate in nutmeg, season, and bubble until thick, then stir in the cream.
Preheat the oven to 190C. Add the turnip, leek, prawns, and herbs to the dish. Stir the lemon zest and juice into the sauce, pour over, and mix gently.
Top with mashed potato peaks, sprinkle over the cheese, and bake 35-40 minutes until golden. Serve with wilted greens.

ingredients.preparation: 1 whole garlic bulb (~12 cloves) plus 4 crushed cloves, combined
jarred roasted red peppers, using bell-pepper as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Combine the garlic, paprika, 4 tbsp olive oil, rosemary, and a large pinch of salt. Slash the lamb shoulder all over and rub in. Marinate up to 24 hours if time allows.
Heat the oven to 150C/130C fan/gas 2. Warm the remaining oil in a large casserole, add the onions, carrots, and garlic bulb, and cook 5 minutes until softened.
Pour in the stock and bring to a boil. Nestle the lamb into the pan, cover, and roast 2 hours.
Uncover and transfer the lamb to a plate. Stir the beans, peppers, and olives through the stock.
Return the lamb on top and cook uncovered 1 hour 30 minutes until fully cooked. Shred with forks and stir the parsley through the beans before serving.
Marinate the beef with salt, sesame oil, pepper, egg white, 2 tbsp of the cornstarch, and 1 tbsp of the oil.
Brown the beef in the remaining oil and set aside.
Sauté the ginger and garlic, then add all the vegetables with the cooking wine and water.
Stir in the oyster sauce, hot sauce, and sugar, then combine with the cooked beef and soy sauce.
Thicken with a cornstarch-water slurry made from the remaining cornstarch, stirred in gradually until the desired consistency is reached.

ingredients.preparation: 2 sticks fresh rosemary, estimated as dried equivalent

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 140C/120C fan/gas 1. Heat the goose fat in an ovenproof pan and briefly sear the pork, then lower the heat.
Add the onion, garlic, carrot, and fennel seeds and soften. Pour in the vinegar, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the stock, tomato purée, and half the herbs. Bring to a boil, simmer 10 minutes, then cover and bake 2 hours, uncovering for the final hour.
Stir in the beans 30 minutes before the end of cooking.
Top with the remaining herbs and breadcrumbs, drizzle with oil, then broil 5-10 minutes until golden. Serve with crusty bread and greens.

ingredients.preparation: stewing beef cut into strips; using steak-sirloin as the closest ontology match
4 kaffir lime leaves, approximated with a small amount of lime zest as the closest ontology match
1 cinnamon stick substituted with ground cinnamon equivalent
red chilli, deseeded and sliced, to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and roast the peanuts 5 minutes until golden. Chop roughly when cool. Lower the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.
Heat the coconut cream in a casserole. Fry the curry paste 1 minute, then coat the beef until sealed.
Add the remaining coconut cream, water, potatoes, onion, lime leaves, cinnamon, tamarind, sugar, fish sauce, and most of the peanuts.
Simmer, cover, and bake 2 hours until the beef is tender.
Top with the sliced chilli and remaining peanuts. Serve with jasmine rice.
Finely slice a quarter of the chilli. Process the remainder with the ginger, garlic, coriander stalks, and a third of the leaves into a rough paste, adding water as needed.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the chicken chunks for 1 minute.
Stir in the paste for another minute, then add the peanut butter, stock, and yogurt.
Simmer gently 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.
Mix in most of the remaining coriander, garnish with the rest plus the sliced chilli. Serve with rice or mashed sweet potato.

ingredients.preparation: 2 cinnamon sticks, estimated as ground equivalent
lamb stock cube plus 500ml water, substituted with chicken-broth as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Dry-fry the pine nuts until lightly toasted, then set aside. Add the oil to the pan and fry the onion and cinnamon together until starting to turn golden.
Increase the heat, add the lamb, and cook until the meat changes colour, then stir in the rice for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, add the apricots, and season to taste.
Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer 12 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the toasted pine nuts and mint before serving.

ingredients.preparation: oxtail substituted with beef-shin as the closest ontology match
1 sprig fresh, chopped, estimated as dried equivalent
375ml combined for the pressure cooker and cornflour slurry

steps.text: Combine the beef with the onion, spring onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, soy sauce, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and brown the meat about 10 minutes until fully browned.
Transfer to a pressure cooker with the water and cook at pressure 25 minutes.
Remove from heat, add the broad beans, and simmer over medium-high heat.
Mix the cornflour with the remaining water and stir into the mixture. Continue cooking and stirring until the sauce thickens and the beans are tender.

name: Sea Bass with Sizzled Ginger, Chilli & Spring Onions

ingredients.preparation: 6 sea bass fillets, substituted with red-snapper as the closest ontology match, ~130g each
large red chilli, thinly shredded, substituted with jalapeño as the closest ontology match

steps.text: Season the fish fillets and make three slits in the skin of each.
Heat oil in a heavy pan and fry the fillets skin-side down 5 minutes until crisp and golden. Flip briefly for 30 seconds to 1 minute, then transfer to a serving plate, cooking in batches.
Heat more oil in the pan and fry the ginger, garlic, and chillies about 2 minutes until golden.
Remove from heat, toss in the spring onions, then drizzle the fish with soy sauce and spoon the aromatic mixture over the top.

name: Slow-Roasted Ham with Lemon, Garlic & Sage

ingredients.preparation: sage leaves, per the herb paste method

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bash the garlic, sage, lemon zest, salt, and pepper together into a paste.
Rub the paste over the pork shoulder, leaving the skin untouched. Score the skin, salt it generously, and secure with kitchen string.
Wrap the pork in foil on a baking tray with the wine poured around the sides. Reduce the temperature to 140C/120C fan/gas 1 and roast 4-5 hours, until a thermometer reads 70C.
Spoon the roasting juices into a saucepan and reduce by a third over medium heat, 10-15 minutes. Season to taste.
Increase the oven to 240C/220C fan/gas 9, expose the skin, and roast 10-15 minutes until browned. Rest 20 minutes before slicing and serving with the sauce.

ingredients.preparation: 900g lamb plus 3 lamb kidneys (~50g each), folded together since there's no separate offal entry in the ontology

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Heat butter in a large shallow casserole and brown the lamb in batches, lifting to a plate.
Fry the onions and carrots with more butter until golden. Sprinkle over the flour and cook briefly.
Add the Worcestershire sauce and stock, bringing to a boil. Stir in the meat and bay leaves, then turn off the heat.
Arrange the sliced potatoes on top of the meat and drizzle with a little more butter.
Cover and bake about 1.5 hours until the potatoes are cooked through.
Remove the lid, brush the potatoes with a little more butter, then turn up the oven or finish under the grill 5-8 minutes until browned.

ingredients.preparation: veal shanks substituted with beef-shin as the closest ontology match; 4 meaty shanks, ~400g each
3 whole for braise, 1 minced for gremolata

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C (300F). Season the shanks and coat in flour.
Brown the shanks in the heated oil and butter until caramelized on both sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Sauté the onion, carrot, celery, and fennel in butter until softened. Add the garlic, orange zest, marjoram, and bay leaf.
Pour in the wine and reduce by half. Add the stock and tomatoes, reducing the total liquid to about 1 cup.
Position the shanks bone-side up in the pot. Cover with parchment and a lid, and braise 2 hours until fork-tender.
Combine the minced garlic, parsley, and lemon zest for the gremolata. Sprinkle half over the shanks and return to the oven uncovered 15 minutes.
Remove the shanks to a platter, skim fat from the braising liquid, and reduce if needed. Plate with the sauce and remaining gremolata.
